blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agentic visual generation produces experience that can improve the native understanding (agent) and generation roles of a unified multimodal backbone, but task success alone does not determine which role should learn. Generator updates can also make the agent's action supervision stale. We introduce RSIgen, a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework linking learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and construct compatible training targets. After generator learning, RSIgen re-evaluates the relative utility of tested actions with branch inputs held fixed to refresh agent supervision; the retained roles then construct the next curriculum. Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2--3.3 points over a three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Wan controls support allocation gains at matched role-level training exposure, refresh gains at a matched adaptation budget, and benefits from updated curriculum sources while recipients continue learning. In blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests, pooled tie-adjusted preference scores against the same baseline reach 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality.
blocks.zh: 代理视觉生成产生的经验可以提高统一多模式主干线的本土理解(代理)和生成角色,但单是任务成功并不能决定哪个角色应该学习. 生成器更新也可以使代理的动作监督僵化. 我们引入了RSIgen,这是一个以任务为中心的相互自我改进框架,将学习分配、监督更新以及课程的循环构建联系起来。 动态责任运行(DRR)在证据、投入方面采用相应的干预措施,并支持选择学习对象和构建相容的培训目标的行动。 在发电机学习后,RSIgen重新评价了经过测试的动作的相对效用,其分支投入被固定下来以更新代理监督;保留的角色然后构建下个课程. 横跨巴格勒,文-伊玛目和万-伊玛目-7B,RSIgen改进了代理 Gen-Bench Full Survery9 以3.2-3.3分的比分通过三周期的SearchGen适应,并具有动作成本. 湾控制在相应的角色级培训风险下支持分配收益,在相应的适应预算下刷新收益,在接受者继续学习的同时从更新的课程来源中获益。 在对200个实际用户请求进行盲目评价时,与同一基线相比,组合式捆绑调整优惠分数达到任务完成率为70.0%,视觉质量为64.9%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agentic visual generation turns an image request into decisions about evidence acquisition, input construction, generation, and repair ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . We study the native-role setting : the agent and generator are the understanding and generation roles of the same unified multimodal backbone. Task success depends on both the agent’s orchestration and the generator’s ability to realize the resulting inputs.
blocks.zh: 代理视觉生成将图像请求转化为关于证据获取、输入构建、生成和修复的决定(Chen等人,2026a); 张等, 2026b ). 我们研究本土-作用设定:代理人和发电机是同一统一的多式联运骨干的理解和生成角色。 任务的成功取决于代理人的管弦和生成者实现所产生投入的能力。

blocks.en: A useful action and a useful training target answer different questions. Consider an architecture poster that places buildings in the wrong chronological order. If correcting the layout instruction fixes the image while the evidence and generator stay unchanged, the correction can train the agent. A validated search-assisted image of the same buildings, paired with an evidence-free request, may instead teach stable historical knowledge to the generator. The final image alone does not identify the learning recipient or supply a compatible target.
blocks.zh: 有用的行动和有用的培训目标回答了不同的问题。 考虑一份建筑海报,将建筑按错误的时间顺序排列. 如果纠正布局指令在证据和生成器保持不变的同时修正图像,则纠正可以训练代理. 同一建筑物的经验证的搜索辅助图像,加上无证据请求,可能反而向生成者传授稳定的历史知识。 最后的图像本身并不能识别学习对象或提供兼容的目标.

blocks.en: Learning by either role reshapes its partner’s next learning problem. If Direct succeeds on reserved uses of newly learned knowledge while Search remains reliable, an earlier search-required label may become stale. Shared architecture does not automatically recalibrate the agent’s policy to the generator’s updated capabilities. This capability–policy calibration aims at appropriate evidence use: volatile facts and instance-specific references retain external dependencies. Better agent inputs and evidence, in turn, change the generator’s next learning opportunities (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 学习任一角色都重塑了伙伴的下一个学习问题。 如果Direct在搜索仍然可靠的情况下在新学到的知识的保留用途上获得成功,那么更早的搜索需要的标签可能会变得僵化. 共享架构不会自动将代理商的政策调整到生成器更新后的能力. 这一能力政策校准旨在适当使用证据:多变的事实和具体案例的参考保留外部依赖性。 更好的代理投入和证据反过来又改变了发电机的下一个学习机会(图1)。

blocks.en: SearchGen already teaches the generator and then recalibrates its reasoner ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , while GenEvolve distills contrasting trajectory experience into an evolving agent ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . Building on these advances, we study three linked decisions: Who should learn? Which actions remain useful after an update? What should the updated roles learn next?
blocks.zh: SearchGen已经教了生成器,然后重新校正其致因器(Wang等人,2026年),而GenEvorve则将轨迹经验对比成演化剂(Chen等人,2026年b). 在这些进展的基础上,我们研究了三项相互关联的决定: 谁该学? 更新后哪些行动仍然有用? 新的角色接下来应该学到什么?

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Reciprocal learning in agentic visual generation. (a) Agent orchestration and generator realization are roles within a unified multimodal model (UMM); PE denotes prompt enhancement. (b) Generator learning changes action utility. (c) Agent learning changes inputs and evidence for later curricula. Images and quality levels are illustrative.
blocks.zh: 图1:代理视觉生成中的对等学习. (a) 代理管弦和生成器实现是统一多式联运模式(UMM)中的角色;PE表示迅速增强。 (b) 发电机学习改变行动效用。 (c) 代理学习改变对以后课程的投入和证据。 图像和质量水平是说明性的。

blocks.en: We introduce RSIgen , a framework for reciprocal self-improvement. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and skill subtypes and construct compatible targets.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 RSIgen, 一个相互自我改善的框架。 动态责任循环(DRR)在证据、投入方面采用了相应的干预措施,并支持选择学习对象和技能子类型以及构建兼容目标的行动。

blocks.en: After generator learning, RSIgen repeats affected action comparisons with the agent, branch inputs, evidence, evaluator, and image seeds fixed. These comparisons refresh supervision according to updated relative action utility across acquisition, input construction, stopping, and supported repair. The agent then learns with the updated generator fixed, and the retained roles construct the next curriculum.
blocks.zh: 在生成器学习后,RSIgen重复了影响与剂,分支输入,证据,评估,图像种子固定的动作比较. 这些比较根据购置、投入建造、停工和辅助修理的相对行动用途更新,更新了监督。 特工随后用更新的生成器固定下来学习,保留的角色构建下一个课程.

blocks.en: Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2–3.3 points over SearchGen-3 + costs, our three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests yields pooled tie-adjusted preferences of 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality against this baseline.
blocks.zh: 在BAGEL、Quen-Image和Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen将AgentGen-Bench Full 总体9 比SearchGen-3 + 成本提高3.2-3/3分,这是我们三个周期的SearchGen 适应和动作成本。 对200个实际用户请求的盲目评价得出了集合的捆绑调整偏好,任务完成率为70.0%,视觉质量为64.9%。

blocks.en: Our contributions, with mechanism studies on Wan, are: • Diagnosis-guided allocation: distinguish execution choices from learning-recipient allocation and construct compatible targets, with gains at matched role-level training exposure. • Supervision refresh: re-evaluate tested pre- and post-generation actions after generator learning, improving adaptation over current-generator on-policy learning at a shared total budget. • Reciprocal curriculum analysis: establish the benefit of updated curriculum sources through controls that freeze those sources while keeping recipient learning active.
blocks.zh: 我们对Wan机制研究的贡献是: 诊断指导性分配:区分执行选择与学习-接受者分配,并构筑相容的目标,在相应的角色培训方面有所收获。 • 监督更新:在发电机学习后重新评价经过测试的生成前和生成后行动,在共享的总预算中改进适应性,而不是当前生成者的政策学习。 • 对等课程分析:通过控制冻结课程来源,确定更新课程来源的益处,同时使接受者积极学习。

blocks.en: Diagnosis-guided allocation: distinguish execution choices from learning-recipient allocation and construct compatible targets, with gains at matched role-level training exposure.
blocks.zh: 诊断指导性分配:将执行选择与学习-接受分配区分开来,构建相容的目标,在相应的角色级培训曝光中有所收获.

blocks.en: Supervision refresh: re-evaluate tested pre- and post-generation actions after generator learning, improving adaptation over current-generator on-policy learning at a shared total budget.
blocks.zh: 监督更新:在发电机学习后重新评价经过测试的生成前和生成后行动,在共享的总预算中比当前生成者的政策学习改进适应。

blocks.en: Reciprocal curriculum analysis: establish the benefit of updated curriculum sources through controls that freeze those sources while keeping recipient learning active.
blocks.zh: 对等课程分析:通过控制冻结这些课程来源,同时使接受者积极学习,确定更新课程来源的好处。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation addresses knowledge and reference requirements through external information. Re-Imagen conditions synthesis on retrieved image–text pairs, while retrieval-augmented diffusion uses retrieved image embeddings ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) . Agentic systems decide how to acquire and use this information: Gen-Searcher learns search decisions with a frozen generator and image/text feedback; ToolArtist learns native multimodal tool use; Qwen-Image-Agent organizes planning, search, and memory; and Unify-Agent jointly supervises textual trajectories and image generation ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . RSIgen studies how experience from this process should train different capabilities and how action supervision should change when the generator also learns.
blocks.zh: 检索的生成通过外部信息解决知识和参考要求。 Re-Imagen条件在检索到的图像上合成-文本对,而检索到的传播使用检索到的图像嵌入(Chen等人,2022年;Rombach等人,2022年). 代理系统决定如何获取和使用这些信息: Gen-Searcher用冷冻生成器和图像/文本反馈来学习搜索决定;工具艺人学习本土多模式工具的使用;Quen-Image-Agent组织规划,搜索和记忆;以及Unify-Agent联合监督文本轨迹和图像生成(Feng等人,2026年;赵等人,2026年;张等人,2026年b;陈等人,2026年a). RSIgen研究如何从这一进程中积累经验来培训不同的能力,以及当生成者也学习时,如何改变行动监督。

blocks.en: SearchGen trains the generator with Diffusion-DPO and recalibrates the reasoner through positive-advantage rejection finetuning with the updated generator ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Generator-dependent adaptation is therefore already part of its design. RSIgen adds matched diagnosis for recipient-specific targets and explicit re-evaluation of acquisition and repair supervision. SearchGen-3 + costs is our local three-cycle extension of the original single DPO–RFT pass, so both systems undergo repeated adaptation. GenEvolve extracts structured experience from contrasting same-request trajectories and supplies it to a privileged teacher for token-level distillation ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . RSIgen instead asks which role should learn from a validated experience and when its action labels should be reconsidered.
blocks.zh: SearchGen用Difmusion-DPO对发电机进行训练,并通过正向偏好拒绝微调与更新的发电机对原因器进行校正(Wang等人,2026年). 因此,依赖发电机的适应已经是其设计的一部分。 RSIgen增加了针对受援对象的匹配诊断,并明确重新评价购置和维修监督。 SearchGen-3 + 成本是我们原先单张DPO-RFT通行证的本地三周期延长,因此两个系统都经过反复的改造. GenEvorve从对比同要求的轨迹中提取出结构化的经验,并提供给一位特权教师进行象征性的蒸馏(Chen等人,2026b.). RSIgen则询问,哪些角色应该从经过验证的经验中学习,何时应该重新考虑其行动标签。

blocks.en: HermesFlow aligns cross-task preferences; UniRL and UniCorn construct multimodal learning tasks from generated experience; SUDER introduces dual self-rewards; and Ask, Solve, Generate alternates role-specific updates ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Mao et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2026a ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Thawkar et al., 2026 ) . Internal Gap revisits previously underutilized samples as capabilities improve, while Dreaming in Flow combines flow-level feedback with visual replay grounding ( Han et al., 2026b ; Hao et al., 2026 ) . RSIgen couples the roles through curriculum construction and action supervision: generator learning changes useful agent decisions, and agent learning changes the experience available for later generator training. Its construction-source controls evaluate the latter direction while recipients continue learning.
blocks.zh: HermesFlow 协调跨任务偏好; UniRL 和 UniCorn 根据生成的经验构建多式联运学习任务; SUDER 引入双重自我奖励;和 Ask, Solve, 生成替代角色特定更新(Yang等人,2025年; Mao等人,2025年;Han等人,2026年a;Hong等人,2025年;Thawkar等人,2026年). 内部 差距随着能力的提高而重新审视以前利用不足的样本,而 " 流动中的梦想 " 则将流量反馈与视觉重播地面相结合(Han等人,2026b); Hao et al., 2026 (英语). RSIgen通过课程构建和动作监督扮演角色: 发电机学习会改变有用的代理决策,而代理人学习会改变以后发电机培训可用的经验. 它的构造-源控制在接受者继续学习的同时评价后一个方向.

blocks.en: Flow matching, DPO, Diffusion-DPO, and GRPO provide the underlying optimization tools ( Lipman et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) . Flow-GRPO, T2I-R1, UniGRPO, and UniRL-Zero apply outcome-driven optimization to generation or multimodal reasoning ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Understanding-based rewards provide feedback for multimodal learning ( Pan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . RSIgen uses completed-image rewards and trajectory costs for RL, with probes selecting curricula and validated trajectories providing action supervision. COMA assigns credit within policy optimization, whereas DRR assigns compatible learning targets before optimization ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) . SPIN and self-rewarding models also use model-generated supervision ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) . RSIgen updates capability roles under a fixed outer protocol, rather than modifying agent implementations or improvement mechanisms ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 流程匹配、DPO、Difusion-DPO和GRPO提供了基本的优化工具(Lipman等人,2022年;Rafailov等人,2023年;Wallace等人,2023年;Shao等人,2024年). Flow-GRPO、T2I-R1、UniGRPO和UniRL-Zero将成果驱动优化应用于生成或多模式推理(Liu等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年a年)。 基于理解的奖励为多模式学习提供了反馈(Pan等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025b;Jin等人,2025年)。 RSIgen使用完成图像奖励和RL的轨迹成本,由探测器选择课程和经验证的轨迹提供动作监督. COMA在政策优化范围内分配信用,而DRR则在优化之前分配兼容的学习目标(Foerster等人,2018年). SPIN和自我奖励模型也使用模型产生的监督(Chen等人,2024年;Yuan等人,2024年)。 RSIgen更新固定外协议下的能力角色,而不是修改代理执行或改进机制(Zhang等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年a).

blocks.en: SRUM freezes its understanding evaluator while training generation, and Endogenous Reprompting freezes generation while learning evaluation and reprompting ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . GEMS and Mind-Brush broaden agentic generation through memory, skills, search, and reasoning ( He et al., 2026b ; He et al., 2026a ) . DAgger addresses the distribution induced by a changing policy ( Ross et al., 2011 ) ; RSIgen additionally considers changing action utility induced by generator learning.
blocks.zh: SRUM在培训生成时冻结其理解评价员,内源再生在学习评估和再生时冻结生成(Jin等人,2025年;Tang等人,2026年). GEMS和Mind-Brush通过记忆、技能、搜索和推理拓宽了代理生成(He等人,2026年b; He等人, 2026a). Dagger处理由变化中的政策引起的分配(Ross等人,2011年);RSIgen还考虑了由生成器学习引起的变化动作效用。

blocks.zh: 3 任务-儿科对等自我改进

blocks.en: RSIgen links learning-recipient allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction under a fixed outer protocol (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: RSIgen根据固定外部协议将学习-接受者分配、监督更新和循环课程建设联系起来(图2)。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : RSIgen’s learning procedure. DRR compiles matched probes into typed curricula. Generator learning precedes re-probing and agent learning; retained roles construct the next curriculum. Pool, admission, and sealed evaluation data have separate roles. UMM denotes the unified model’s understanding/orchestration and generation roles. Evaluator feedback and capability memory support training.
blocks.zh: 图2:RSIgen的学习程序。 DRR将匹配的探测器编译为打字课程. 发电机学习先于再测试和代理学习;保留角色构成下一个课程。 宝库,招生,封存的评价数据各有不同的作用. UMM表示统一模型的理解/组合和生成角色. 评价员反馈和能力记忆支持培训。

blocks.en: 4.1 Backbones, benchmark, and comparison methods

blocks.en: We evaluate BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, with mechanism studies on Wan. Qwen-Image uses Qwen2.5-VL as its condition encoder ( Wu et al., 2025 ) ; Wan uses full-parameter updates to the trained role. Within each backbone, trained comparisons share initialization, tools, resource allowances, corresponding seeds, and three update attempts. Direct and prompt enhancement provide untrained inference references.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了BAGEL、Quen-Image和Wan-Image-7B,对Wan进行了机制研究。 Quen-Image使用Quen2.5-VL作为其状态编码器(Wu等人,2025年);Wan使用全参数更新来更新训练的角色。 在每个骨干网中,经过培训的比较共享初始化、工具、资源津贴、相应的种子以及三次更新尝试。 直接和迅速的增强提供了未经培训的推论参考。

blocks.en: Agentic initialization is the starting tool-using pair. Agent-only adaptation follows Gen-Searcher with a fixed generator and RSIgen’s completed-image outcome and trajectory-cost contract; the original Gen-Searcher also uses final-text feedback ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . SearchGen-3 + costs repeats Diffusion-DPO and positive-advantage rejection finetuning for three cycles ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Joint outcome RL trains both roles from terminal outcomes. Uniform reciprocal learning shares RSIgen’s role-specific optimization stages and refresh, while changing curriculum allocation. Uniform and failure-locus comparisons evaluate the curriculum package; one-sided updates test which roles need to learn.
blocks.zh: 代理初始化是开始使用工具的配对. 仅代理适应跟随Gen-Searcher使用一台固定的发电机,RSIgen的完成图像结果和轨迹成本合同;原Gen-Searcher也使用最终文本反馈(Feng等人,2026年). SearchGen-3 + 成本重复传播-DPO和正优拒绝微调三个周期(Wang等人,2026年). 共同成果RL从终端结果中培养出两个角色. 统一对等学习共享RSIgen特定角色优化阶段和刷新,同时改变课程分配. 统一和失败障碍比较评价课程包;片面更新测试哪些角色需要学习。

blocks.en: AgentGen-Bench contains 751 requests. We follow its released Overall9 aggregation and evaluator ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ; the original paper called it SearchGen-Bench. Overall9 averages Checklist, Rubric, Prompt Faithfulness, Image Quality, Text Rendering, AI Naturalness, Composition, Physical Plausibility, and Visual Reference, excluding Text Reference. NoSearch (NS) and Search-Intensive (SI) are the benchmark strata; Full is the global mean over each model’s scored coverage. Applicable metric denominators differ, so averaging displayed components or nominal-count weighting of rounded NS/SI scores need not reproduce Full. Public rows have model-dependent coverage: Nano Banana Pro reports 738/751 scored requests and GPT-Image-2 718/751, whereas the published BAGEL and Qwen-Image rows cover 751/751. For example, the former’s published Full 65.0 differs from 64.9 obtained by nominal-count weighting of its rounded stratum scores. Evaluation references are distinct from runtime retrieval inputs and training targets. Dataset and public-result definitions follow the benchmark release and project results .
blocks.zh: Gen -Bench探员有751个请求 我们遵循其发布的《总体9汇总与评估》(Wang等人,2026年);原始论文称之为“搜索源”。 总的来说,9 核对表、Rubric、即时信仰、图像质量、文本渲染、AI 自然、构成、物理色彩和视觉参考,不包括文本参考。 NoSearch(NS)和Search-Intensive(SI)是基准层;Full是每个模型得分覆盖的全球平均值。 适用的计量分母不同,因此四舍五入的NS/SI分数的平均显示组件或名义加权值不需要完全复制。 公共专栏有依赖模型的覆盖: 纳诺香蕉 Pro reports 738/751的得分请求和GPT-Image-2 718/751,而出版的BAGEL和Quen-Image列则涵盖751/751. 例如,前者出版的Full 65.0与其四舍五入分数名义加权得出的64.9不同。 评价参考材料不同于运行时间检索投入和培训目标。 数据集和公共成果定义遵循基准发布和项目成果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Matched mechanism studies
blocks.zh: 4.2 匹配机制研究

blocks.en: The allocation study uses 4,000 opportunities and matches role-level exposure: 1,600 agent items with 3.2M SFT and 2.4M RL tokens, and 2,000 generator items with 4,000 SFT and 7,200 RL image presentations. This comparison is separate from the original curriculum-package ablation.
blocks.zh: 分配研究使用4000个机会,并匹配角色级曝光:1600个代理项目有3.2M SFT和2.4M RL令牌,2000个发电机项目有4000 SFT和7200 RL图像演示. 这种比较与最初的课程组合萎缩是分开的.

blocks.en: The action-refresh diagnostic uses 200 held-out Test-mini requests, separate from training, tuning, checkpoint selection, and the human-evaluation requests. It compares ( G 0 , G 1 ) (G_{0},G_{1}) , ( G 1 , G 2 ) (G_{1},G_{2}) , and ( G 2 , G 3 ) (G_{2},G_{3}) under fixed prompts, evidence, action packages, and paired image seeds, with 200 canonical post-states per stage. Action probing uses eight images per action/version. Stale-label and refresh continuation share agent initialization, training requests, the updated rollout generator, and realized token/training-compute budgets. A separate Stage-2 comparison additionally includes current-generator on-policy learning and matches preparation, rollout, and optimization within a common 100-unit budget: c = 100 ​ C / B adapt c=100C/B_{\mathrm{adapt}} , so one unit is 1% of the single-stage budget.
blocks.zh: 重新行动诊断采用200项搁置试验-小型请求,与培训、调试、检查站选择和人力评价请求分开。 它比较(G0,G1)(G_{0},G_{1}),(G1,G2)(G_{1},G_{2}),和(G2,G3)(G_{2},G_{3})在固定的提示,证据,动作包和对映图像种子下,每个阶段有200个犬形后状态. 动作探测每个动作/版本使用8个图像. Stale-label和刷新续订共享代理初始化、培训请求、更新的推出生成器以及实现的代号/培训计算预算。 单独的第2阶段比较还包含当前生成者关于政策的学习和匹配准备,推出,以及在共同的100个单位预算内的优化: c = 100 C / B 适应 c = 100 C / B = 100 m_{\mathrm{adapt}}},所以一个单位是单阶段预算的1%.

blocks.en: Construction-source controls keep recipient learning and current-partner RL active, while freezing the agent, generator, or both as curriculum sources. Every arm uses 1,800 agent and 2,200 generator records per attempt, totaling 5,400 and 6,600. Separate role evaluation uses 200 requests and four image seeds per request/state; agent evaluation fixes G 0 G_{0} , and generator evaluation distinguishes direct and assisted inputs.
blocks.zh: 建筑-源控制使接收者学习和当前合作伙伴RL活动,同时冻结代理,生成器,或两者作为课程源. 每只手臂每次尝试使用1800剂和2200个发电机记录,总计5400个和6600个. 单独的角色评价每个请求/状态使用200个请求和4个图像种子;代理评价修正G 0 G_{0},生成器评价区分直接和辅助输入.

blocks.en: 4.3 Human judgments, statistical units, and resource accounting
blocks.zh: 4.3 人的判断、统计单位和资源核算

blocks.en: Human evaluation compares RSIgen with SearchGen-3 + costs on the same 200 real-user requests across all three backbones. Three independent blind ratings per pair assess task completion and visual quality, giving 600 judgments per backbone and 1,800 pooled judgments per dimension. Preference credits a tie as half a win. Repeated ratings and reuse across backbones do not increase the number of distinct requests.
blocks.zh: 人类评价将RSIgen与SearchGen-3+成本比对了所有三个骨干相同的200个真用户请求. 每对独立失明评级3次,评估任务完成情况和视觉质量,每个主干单位有600项判断,每个维度有1 800项集合判断。 偏好得分是半赢 重复评级和跨骨干重复使用不会增加不同请求的数量.

blocks.en: Main benchmark results aggregate multiple training seeds. The continuation diagnostic uses 10,000 paired request-cluster bootstrap replicates, retaining all stages, matched branches, and policy arms for each sampled request. Conditional metrics recompute their numerators and denominators in each resample before the equal-weight stage mean. The resulting percentile 95% intervals quantify request variation conditional on checkpoints and frozen evidence, separately from variation across training runs. Image seeds are generation replicates; sequential stages describe progression. Searches and generations/edits are counted per request, with different calls potentially having different compute and latency costs. Failed calls and rejected attempts consume their assigned budgets.
blocks.zh: 主要基准结果汇总了多种培训种子。 持续诊断使用10 000对对请求-集群靴子复制,保留所有阶段、匹配的分支以及政策臂,用于每个抽样请求。 条件度量衡在等重级表示前,在每次重采样中重新计算其计数器和分母. 因此,95%的间隔以检查站和冻结证据为条件,将请求的数量变化与整个培训周期的差异分开。 图像种子是生成复制品;相继阶段描述进步. 搜索和代数/编辑按请求计算,不同的呼叫可能具有不同的计算和延迟成本。 失败的呼叫和被拒绝的尝试消耗其分配的预算。

blocks.en: 5.4 Action utility shifts and post-generator adaptation
blocks.zh: 5.4 行动公用事业转移和生成后适应

blocks.en: The diagnostic distinguishes changes in action utility from the policy’s response to new supervision. Old/new generator comparisons fix the agent, enhanced prompts, search evidence, references, source images, continuation, evaluator, and paired seeds. Search branches retain their artifacts and logical call costs, including when retrieval yields no usable evidence. A canonical post-state uses the same source image for both checkpoints and continuation arms. Accept returns that image; regeneration and reference-conditioned regeneration use the fixed input packages; LocalEdit is included only when the localized repair is identifiable and supported by both checkpoints. Edit ineligibility removes the action, while retaining the state in the other post-action metrics.
blocks.zh: 诊断将行动效用的变化与政策对新监督的反应区分开来。 旧/新生成器的比较可以固定剂、增强的提示、搜索证据、参考文献、源图像、延续、评价者和配对种子。 搜索分支保留其文物和逻辑通话费用,包括当检索未产生可用证据时。 警犬后国对检查站和继续武器使用相同的源头图像。 接受返回图像; 重生和参考条件重生使用固定的输入包; 本地化的修复只有在可以识别并得到两个检查站支持时才包括在内。 编辑无资格删除动作,同时保留其他动作后度量表中的状态.

blocks.en: There are 200 evaluated pre-generation requests and 200 post-states per stage. Across 600 stage–request observations, text and image search yield no usable evidence in 162 (27.0%) and 204 (34.0%) cases, with zero infrastructure failures after retries. LocalEdit is eligible for 126, 121, and 116 states across the stages. Empty retrieval outcomes remain included in action values. End-to-end Mini O9 evaluates the separate complete policy workflow, including its chosen queries and induced state distribution.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The original uniform and failure-locus comparisons evaluate the diagnostic curriculum package. The matched-exposure allocation study isolates its benefit at equal role-level training volume; the matched-budget Stage-2 study compares refresh with ordinary current-generator adaptation. Construction-source freezes keep recipient learning active and measure the contribution of updated peers to curriculum content, validity/yield, and freshness. Their effects should be interpreted jointly rather than as a unique decomposition of causal responsibility.
blocks.zh: 最初的统一和故障障碍比较评价诊断课程包. 相匹配的接触分配研究将其惠益隔离在平等的角色级培训量中;相匹配的预算阶段二研究将新鲜度与普通的流源体适应度进行比较. 建筑-源冻结使受助者积极学习,并衡量更新的同伴对课程内容、有效性/产量和新鲜度的贡献。 它们的影响应共同解释,而不是作为因果责任的独特分解。

blocks.en: For Wan, the descriptive difference-in-differences of the final source-control endpoints is 47.5 − 44.8 − 44.0 + 42.8 = 1.5 47.5-44.8-44.0+42.8=1.5 . This contrast summarizes combined content and target-yield effects; the primary result is the 4.7-point advantage of current over jointly frozen sources. Role trajectories also distinguish improving system quality from monotonic gains of every component under a fixed partner.
blocks.zh: 对Wan来说,最终源控制端点的描述性差异是47.5−44.8−44.0+42.8=1.5 47.5-44.8-44.0+42.8=1.5. 这一对比总结了综合内容和目标产生的效果;主要结果是当前来源相对于联合冻结来源的4.7点优势。 角色轨迹也把改进系统质量与固定伙伴下每个部件的单调收益区分开来.

blocks.en: Mechanism studies use Wan, whereas the benchmark improvements are evaluated across three backbones. Action comparisons use finite shared probe banks; their intervals measure request variation conditional on the trained checkpoints and frozen evidence. Human preferences are descriptive summaries of the evaluated real-user sample. Routing is an operational learning hypothesis rather than unique causal identification, and source controls change content and target yield together. The protected-capability tolerance is local to each accepted update; permitted losses can accumulate across successive steps.
blocks.zh: 机制研究使用Wan,而基准改进则在三个骨干部门进行评价。 行动比较使用有限的共享探测库;其间隔量度要求以训练有素的检查站和冻结的证据为条件而变化。 人类偏好是对被评价的真用户样本的描述性总结. routing是一种操作性的学习假说,而不是独特的因果识别,源头控制着改变内容和共同的目标产量. 每次接受更新时,保护能力耐受性是局部的;允许的损失可连续累积。

blocks.en: Current agentic visual generation systems, whether built from separate understanding and generation models or a unified model, often understand task requirements more reliably than they can realize them in generated images. RSIgen uses this capability asymmetry to improve collaboration between understanding and generation, translating stronger understanding into more effective supervision and better system-level performance. Nevertheless, the extent of further improvement remains constrained by the generative capabilities of the underlying models. Larger advances therefore also depend on improving these models’ ability to translate understood requirements into faithful visual outputs.
blocks.zh: 目前的代理视觉生成系统,无论是通过单独的理解和生成模型还是统一的模型构建的,往往更可靠地理解任务要求,而不是在生成的图像中实现这些要求. RSIgen利用这种能力不对称来增进理解与生成之间的协作,将更强的理解转化为更有效的监督,以及更好的系统层面的性能. 尽管如此,进一步改进的程度仍然受到基本模型遗传能力的制约。 因此,更大的进步还取决于提高这些模型将理解的要求转化为忠实的视觉产出的能力。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: RSIgen connects diagnosis-guided learning allocation, supervision refresh, and reciprocal curriculum construction. It improves AgentGen-Bench quality across three backbones, with complementary human preferences on 200 real-user requests. Wan controls show allocation and refresh gains at matched exposure and adaptation budget, while source controls connect recursive improvement to target validity and supervision freshness at fixed curriculum sizes. The role trajectories highlight the importance of adapting coordination as capabilities change. Section 6 discusses the scope and limitations.
blocks.zh: RSIgen将诊断指导的学习分配、监督更新和对等的课程建设联系起来。 它提升了AgentGen-Bench在三个骨干上的质量,在200个真用户请求上具有互补的人类偏好. 湾控制显示在相应的接触和适应预算中分配和刷新收益,而源控制则将递归性改进与目标有效性和监督固定课程规模的新鲜度联系起来。 作用轨迹突出了随着能力变化调整协调的重要性。 第6节讨论了范围和限制。
